VI.description: One game tick, a state machine over the phases Title, Ready, Playing, Paused, Dying, Treasure, LevelDone, GameOver, Name, Demo. Title: card, short instructions, then the highscore table, then the demo; Enter starts, Esc quits. Ready: short pause with a message. Playing: Game_Play; a hit or a deadly fall starts Dying, the treasure room starts Treasure. Paused: Space, Enter or an arrow continues, Esc/P again ends the game (GameOver). Dying: one life less, then Ready at the arrival point or GameOver. Treasure: playing against the clock, then LevelDone and the next level. GameOver: then Name entry (arrows choose letters, Enter saves) when the score is good enough, else Title. Sound bits for the audio loop; music during Ready, Playing, Treasure. Keys: 0 None, 1 Up, 2 Down, 3 Left, 4 Right, 5 Quit, 6 Pause, 7 Start, 8 Jump, 9 Release, 10 ReleaseV, 11 ReleaseL, 12 ReleaseR, 13 Cheat.
